parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const sub=r.subscription||r.input?.subscription||{};const event=r.event||r.input?.event||{};if(!sub.id||!sub.customer_id) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C3-G',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'MISSING_SUBSCRIPTION_IDENTITY',message:'subscription.id and customer_id are required.'},next_action:'provide_subscription'}}];const status=event.type==='payment_failed'?'past_due':event.type==='subscription_cancelled'?'cancelled':event.type==='payment_succeeded'?'active':sub.status||'pending';const attempt=Number(sub.failed_attempts||0)+(event.type==='payment_failed'?1:0);const max=Number(sub.max_failed_attempts||3);const shouldRetry=status==='past_due'&&attempt<max;return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C3-G',component_version:'v1',subscription_state:{...sub,status,failed_attempts:attempt,last_event:event.type||null},billing_action:status==='past_due'?(shouldRetry?'schedule_retry':'manual_review'):status==='cancelled'?'stop_future_billing':'record_event',next_action:status==='past_due'&&!shouldRetry?'manual_review':'update_subscription_state',error:null}}];
